title: DBZ Inspired Prototype (iOS)
author: Kulimar
selftext:
**Timeline:** 5 Weeks from concept to demo  
  
**Approach:** I used AI to built the Editor that allows me to hand tune and live update any and every aspect of the game from the environment, controls, skills, vfx, etc. Everything is also data driven through csv and linked to a google sheet for ease of tuning

**Next Steps:** I've got the core loop sorted and I'm mainly looking to continue to iterate on the pacing, progression, and content (I plan to replace all of the content over time. It's all prototype for now). Links below if you're interested in playtesting and providing feedback:

**Links to Play:**

**iOS**: [https://testflight.apple.com/join/egn4ERSc](https://testflight.apple.com/join/egn4ERSc)  
**Android**: You'll have to DM me your e-mail and I can add you to the tester list

comments.author: Kulimar
comments.body:
If you do end up trying it out, here's what I'd be curious about

\---  
**Feedback I'm Looking For:**

* In your own words, what do you think you're supposed to be doing in the game?
* What were you thinking about most while you were playing?
* What was your strategy to progress?
* What did you find frustrating, difficult, or confusing? What did you expect to happen?
* What was your favorite moment? Why?
* When did you feel the most powerful or skilled?
* Which actions, abilities, or mechanics did you use the most? Which did you mostly ignore? Why?
* Was there anything you wanted to do, but couldn't?
* How would you describe this game to a friend?
* If you could change one thing about the game, what would you change?
* Any other feedback you'd like to give.

**Notes:**

* All Art, Music, SFX, and UI is placeholder and will be replaced
* Only difficulty and reward tuning up to Ascension 4 has had a pass, but nothing beyond that yet
* Will add Special Thanks credit to anyone that is able to provide feedback at this early stage :)
